admin.projects.description: Projects are managed separately from connector access. A project may be a member of more than one connector.

admin.public_url.title: Canonical public URL
admin.connectors.description: Connector settings control Knowledge, Workspace, and bridge access. Workspace tools and transfer are on by default and can be turned off per connector or per project.
admin.oauth.clients_description: These are live OAuth authorizations. Each client is grouped by connector resource and shows current project access; connector definitions and authorizations are separate controls.
admin.workspaces.settings_description: One persistent Workspace per credential or OAuth grant, shared across chats. It is created automatically on first use; Pin retains files indefinitely.
admin.workspaces.connectors_description: Workspace-only surfaces are independent from Knowledge connectors and accept named static credentials only. Each active credential owns one persistent Workspace.
admin.authentication.description: OAuth and named static credentials are independent ways to authenticate. Static secrets are surface-scoped, encrypted for recovery, and shown only after current-password reauthentication.
